view_frame: Front view (XZ plane) shows the knob face with three protrusions. Top view (XY plane) shows the trapezoidal side profile. Right view (YZ plane) shows the side profile. X is width, Y is depth, Z is height.

features.placement: Extruded along Z from Z=0 to Z=height. Centered at X=0, Y=0.
features.evidence: Top and right views show a trapezoidal profile.

features.placement: Extruded along Y from Y=0 to Y=protrusion_depth. Located at X=-base_width/2, Z=height/2.
features.evidence: Front view shows a rectangular protrusion on the left.

features.placement: Extruded along Y from Y=0 to Y=protrusion_depth. Located at X=base_width/2*cos(60), Z=height/2+base_width/2*sin(60).
features.evidence: Front view shows a rectangular protrusion on the top right.

features.placement: Extruded along Y from Y=0 to Y=protrusion_depth. Located at X=base_width/2*cos(-60), Z=height/2+base_width/2*sin(-60).
features.evidence: Front view shows a rectangular protrusion on the bottom right.

connections: protrusion_1 connects to knob_body at X=-base_width/2
protrusion_2 connects to knob_body at X=base_width/2*cos(60), Z=height/2+base_width/2*sin(60)
protrusion_3 connects to knob_body at X=base_width/2*cos(-60), Z=height/2+base_width/2*sin(-60)
edit_rules: Changing base_width affects the position of all protrusions.
Changing height affects the position of all protrusions.
Changing protrusion_depth affects the Y extent of all protrusions.
unresolved: Missing dimensions for knob body (base_width, top_width, height).
Missing dimensions for protrusions (protrusion_width, protrusion_height, protrusion_depth).
